title: Mi-17 / Mi-171 Hip

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The Mi-17 is the export name of the Mi-8MT and Mi-8MTV family, the most-built helicopter in the world: a big twin-engine transport helicopter with the two pilots side by side and a flight engineer between them. It has the same TV3-117 engines and the same cockpit layout as the Mi-8MTV2 that DCS models, so this guide follows that cockpit. Mi-171 versions differ in their radios and navigation equipment, and the newest Mi-171Sh have glass screens, which this guide does not cover.
